title: Add defensive frame_length bounds check in receive_frame
description: In link_layer.rs line 639, `frame_length as u8` relies on frame parsing to enforce MAX_FRAME_BODY <= 254. Add explicit assertion before cast to make safety invariant visible at point of use and prevent regression if frame.rs changes. Example: `debug_assert!(frame_length <= u8::MAX as usize);` or return FrameTooLarge error.
